reuse.why: Adds one shared isHoliday and replaces all three holiday-membership checks (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getDatesInRange) with it, but leaves the surrounding 'isWeekend || holiday' test written out at each of those sites instead of sharing it as one predicate.

duplication.why: Adds no copied logic; the existing weekend-or-holiday expression is still repeated three times, which the change did not create but kept.

placement.why: The predicate lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend helpers and the server handler imports it.

scope.why: Only the holiday matcher, its three call sites and a test.

maintainability.why: The MM-DD rule is defined once and easy to change; the import is slightly out of order and the composite non-business-day check is still spread around.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every holiday check now goes through isHoliday.

disguised_duplication.where: The three includes() checks are replaced by calls to the shared isHoliday, not reshaped.
